subject: general
question: Which of the following awards is presented for lifetime achievement in sports and games? It was instituted to honour those sportspersons who have contributed to sports by their performance and continue to contribute to the promotion of sports even after their retirement from an active sporting career.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dhyanchand Award**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Dhyanchand Award** is presented for lifetime achievement in sports and games.
 
• It was instituted to honor those sportspersons who have contributed to sports by their performance and continue to contribute to the promotion of sports even after their retirement from an active sporting career.
 
• The award is named after the legendary Indian hockey player, Major Dhyan Chand, who is considered one of the greatest field hockey players in history.
 
• Recipients of this award are chosen based on their performance and contribution to the field of sports, both during and after their active sports career.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Arjuna Award** is given for outstanding performance in sports and games.
 
• The **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna** is India's highest sporting honor awarded for the most outstanding performance in sports.
 
• The **Dronacharya Award** is presented to coaches for producing medal winners at prestigious international sports events.
 
• The Dhyanchand Award was established in 2002 and is one of the highest honors for lifetime achievement in sports in India.
 
• Recipients of the Dhyanchand Award receive a statuette, a certificate, ceremonial dress, and a cash prize.
